programs.title: The Animal Within
programs.desc: Each species has undergone eons of beta testing, animal vs. animal, animal vs. element and even animal vs. human; take a peek under the hood of these critters; what does it take to make them top performers?

programs.title: Cursed Histories
programs.sub_title: Abandon All Hope Diamond, The Bard's Warning, Cursed Pebbles Of Koh Hin
programs.desc: The Hope diamond makes its way across the world; William Shakespeare's remains are at the center of centuries-old rumors; a god enacts consequences on those who dare to steal from the island he shaped centuries ago.

programs.title: Fishing for History
programs.desc: Dateline 1903, 4:10am. One of the largest and deadliest rock slides in Canadian history nearly buried the mining town including its local bank. In the years after, a legend of 500,000 lost banknotes floated around.

programs.title: Digital Tsunami: Big Tech, Big AI, Big Brother
programs.desc: This documentary will examine how toxic elements of digital environment are dramatically transforming society in negative ways, just as the prophetic, popular futurist Marshall McLuhan predicted 60 years ago. Examining the unforeseen social and political problems caused by the digital revolution, and highlight the need for laws and regulations to protect citizens, especially the most vulnerable.

programs.title: Deadly Science
programs.desc: The spirit of exploration drives scientists into extreme environments; biochemist Peng Jiamu vanishes in the Lop Desert; navigator Jean-François La Pérouse faces treacherous seas while seeking the Northwest Passage.

programs.title: I Died... And Came Back
programs.desc: A woman is hit by a truck while crossing the street, plunging her into an out-of-body experience that profoundly changes her life; a medical mishap causes a journey into a realm of light for a quadriplegic man.

programs.title: Mapping Disaster
programs.desc: From the Hindenburg disaster, to the Iceland Eruption, Chornobyl, the Dust Bowl Drought, and the Cascadia Earthquake; the science and engineering behind these events, and the lessons learned.

programs.title: Ghosts Off Grid
programs.desc: Jordyn and Johnny are in Moose Jaw, Saskatchewan, home to tunnels that sprawl underneath most of the city's downtown. While much of the system has been converted into a tourist attraction, some residue of the spirit realm still clings onto the space.

programs.title: Quest for the Lost Vikings
programs.desc: The search for the lost Viking continues, with the team venturing further into Minnesota lore as residents offer up theories of what happened to the lost Viking. The team is led to multiple sites where remnants of the lost Viking voyage may reside.

programs.title: Alien Corridors
programs.desc: California is home to many sightings of unidentified flying objects; the state's size contributes to explained and unexplained sightings.

programs.title: To Kill a Dictator
programs.desc: Under Saddam Hussein's rule, fearsome purges, mass genocides, political executions, and invasions of neighboring powers become the norm; early murderous tendencies set the stage for years of ruthless resolve.

programs.title: Phantom Signals
programs.desc: A Russian radio station has broadcast a signal nonstop since the Cold War, and no one knows why; experts use hi-tech methods to investigate what it is and what might happen if it ever stops.
